import hashlib

Prime = 
Generator = 2
a = 0xca7693246391f9cc12e3a631ed2fb3fb0bf67538ef7c36ca9eb2df2430e50b3dca75a2033363e0a86c09ab348e21f4f93a3b88732531302d367fb7de51b63574d1e8b10206afccdbf2144e921a5736636273352c7065ade67b764a304e8b8178f75a983f79c3fad999aa5809810ef3473c65ddaa645ef4b8ce2e0ddb2eea17e4
b = 0xe4539485b7efb7d9d635088ffb6a85c88ca83431127057c3c641bf3de1f9b8eb3eecc367dbc80b7872466a91739c5e65f9c68a43c2980f2a585dce10cc475830300f17dd7306271e71f4ead016630b29d4e27007f86774ee816dfeae43bc58cb460b4b57c83ed77b113edc1a023e51ce43003e8423a1a4a66a9f8cb01a0f1cd0

class DiffieHellman:
    def __init__(self):
        self.prime = Prime
        self.generator = Generator
        self.private_key_alice = a
        self.private_key_bob = b

    def generate_public_keys(self):
        self.public_key_alice = pow(self.generator, self.private_key_alice, self.prime)
        self.public_key_bob = pow(self.generator, self.private_key_bob, self.prime)

    def generate_shared_secret(self):
        self.shared_secret_alice = '{:x}'.format(pow(self.public_key_bob, self.private_key_alice, self.prime))
        self.shared_secret_bob = '{:x}'.format(pow(self.public_key_alice, self.private_key_bob, self.prime))

    def shared_secret_to_sha512(self):
        self.hash_alice = hashlib.sha512(self.shared_secret_alice.encode())
        self.hash_bob = hashlib.sha512(self.shared_secret_bob.encode())
        self.key_alice = self.hash_alice.hexdigest()
        self.key_bob = self.hash_bob.hexdigest()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    calc = DiffieHellman()
    calc.generate_public_keys()
    print('Alice Public Key:', hex(calc.public_key_alice), '\n')
    print('Bob Public Key:', hex(calc.public_key_bob), '\n')
    calc.generate_shared_secret()
    print('Shared Secret Alice:', format(calc.shared_secret_alice), '\n')
    print('Shared Secret Bob:', calc.shared_secret_bob, '\n')
    calc.shared_secret_to_sha512()
    print('Alice Hashed Key:', calc.key_alice, '\n')
    print('Bob Hashed Key:', calc.key_bob, '\n')
